"""
review_pr_record.py — settle the one reviewer rule whose condition is a fact about
the PR body, from the PR record `loadout-review run` writes beside findings.json.

The chunk reviewer sees diff chunks only, so it raised `amos.path-choice.5` ("no
CREW_SOP section 6 record in the PR body") on PRs whose body carried a complete
record, and kept raising it round after round. The run records the title and body
it fetched at the reviewed head in `pr.json` (schema `loadout.review-pr/1`); this
module reads that file and resolves the candidate mechanically, so the verdict no
longer depends on the reviewer remembering to check.

Only the false "record is missing" claim is removed. Whether the record is
adequate stays a human or orchestrator question.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, NamedTuple

RULE_ID = "amos.path-choice.5"
PR_RECORD_SCHEMA = "loadout.review-pr/1"

#: The heading AMoS writes ("CREW_SOP section 6 record", "CREW_SOP §6 ..."), found
#: case-insensitively. A record is this heading followed, anywhere after it, by
#: evidence wording from `RECORD_EVIDENCE_RE`; a heading with no evidence after it
#: is a mention, not a record.
RECORD_HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"CREW_SOP\s*(?:§\s*|section\s+)6\b", re.IGNORECASE)
RECORD_EVIDENCE_RE = re.compile(r"captured|pending (?:post-merge )?real run", re.IGNORECASE)

DROP_REASON = "section 6 record present in PR body (pr.json)"
TRUNCATED_REASON = "PR body truncated; record not verifiable"


class Resolution(NamedTuple):
    """What the PR record decided: the findings to carry on (a downgraded candidate
    rewritten as a nit), the numbers to drop with their reasons, a record per
    downgrade, and one line per unchanged candidate saying why."""

    findings: list[dict[str, Any]]
    drops: dict[int, str]
    downgrades: list[dict[str, Any]]
    notes: list[str]


def has_section_6_record(body: str) -> bool:
    """True iff `body` holds the section 6 heading followed by evidence wording."""
    return any(RECORD_EVIDENCE_RE.search(body, match.end()) for match in RECORD_HEADING_RE.finditer(body))


def load_record(path: Path | None, findings_head: str | None) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str]:
    """(the PR record, "") when it can be trusted for this review, else (None, the
    reason it cannot). Trusted means: readable, the expected schema, a string body,
    and a head equal to the head the findings were produced for."""
    if path is None:
        return None, "pr.json path could not be resolved (TMPDIR unset)"
    try:
        document = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None, "pr.json missing"
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return None, f"pr.json unreadable: {exc}"
    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("schema") != PR_RECORD_SCHEMA:
        return None, f"pr.json is not a {PR_RECORD_SCHEMA} document"
    if not isinstance(document.get("body"), str) or not isinstance(document.get("body_truncated"), bool):
        return None, "pr.json has no body/body_truncated"
    record_head = document.get("head_sha")
    if not isinstance(findings_head, str) or not findings_head:
        return None, "findings file carries no head_sha to compare with pr.json"
    if record_head != findings_head:
        return None, f"pr.json head_sha {str(record_head)[:12]} differs from findings head {findings_head[:12]}"
    return document, ""


def _describe(number: int, item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return f"finding {number} ({item.get('file')}:{item.get('line')})"


def resolve(
    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
    findings_head: str | None,
    record_path: Path | None,
    reviewer_drops: dict[int, str],
) -> Resolution:
    """Resolve every `amos.path-choice.5` candidate against the PR record.

    A candidate the reviewer already dropped keeps the reviewer's reason. A record
    that cannot be trusted leaves the candidate as it is and says why."""
    candidates = [
        number for number, item in enumerate(findings)
        if item.get("rule_id") == RULE_ID and number not in reviewer_drops
    ]
    if not candidates:
        return Resolution(findings, {}, [], [])
    record, reason = load_record(record_path, findings_head)
    if record is None:
        notes = [f"{_describe(n, findings[n])} kept: {reason}" for n in candidates]
        return Resolution(findings, {}, [], notes)
    if has_section_6_record(record["body"]):
        return Resolution(findings, {n: DROP_REASON for n in candidates}, [], [])
    if not record["body_truncated"]:
        return Resolution(findings, {}, [], [])
    result = list(findings)
    downgrades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for number in candidates:
        item = findings[number]
        if item.get("severity") != "blocking":
            continue
        result[number] = {**item, "severity": "nit"}
        downgrades.append({
            "file": item.get("file"), "line": item.get("line"), "rule_id": item.get("rule_id"),
            "message": item.get("message"), "reason": f"downgraded to nit: {TRUNCATED_REASON}",
        })
        print(
            f"review-judge: {_describe(number, item)} downgraded blocking -> nit: {TRUNCATED_REASON}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
    return Resolution(result, {}, downgrades, [])
